'''Xochtl''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Xochtl system/Legends|Xochtl system]]. It was situated in the [[Loop Worlds]] area of the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] within the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. A [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] connected it to the [[Bronsoon system/Legends|Bronsoon system]].<ref name="TEA" />

A volatile and rocky world, Xochtl featured crags and spires on its surface as well as [[Gravity/Legends|gravitational]] pull that was slightly lower than standard. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Bagmim]] [[Species/Legends|species]], members of which had already traveled offworld [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] prior to<ref name="TEA" /> [[43 ABY]].<ref name="43 ABY">The main section of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which describes Xochtl, ends with a mention of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]]'s journey across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the beginning of which is depicted in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''. The events of ''Outcast'' are dated to [[43 ABY]] by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Xochtl was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square P-6.<ref name="TEA" />
